2026 年 Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festi: The 2026 Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festival takes place on Main Street on October 17–18, 9 am–5 pm, according to the official directions page. 节庆专心版：到达 Main Street → 选两三个最想看的摊位或节目 → 留: Festival-focused day: arrive at Main Street, choose two or three priority stalls or performances, then leave time for breaks and the trip home. Use the current program rather than last year’s social posts.
